mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals labor market weakness that precedes corporate earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced business investment and consumer demand.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and INDPRO fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%) triggers Federal Reserve tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS MoM change > 100) indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS MoM change > 100.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer demand for housing, which correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through increased construction activity and household spending.
failure_condition: The correlation between HOUST and 60-day SPX returns is negative or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing starts (HOUST < 850) combined with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals a housing market downturn amid accommodative policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer confidence and investment.
regime_hint: weak housing market with low rates
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates economic contraction in manufacturing and services, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate output and profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.
